title: Martyr
name: Anastasia
description: The Martyr is an inured, cheerful girl who was raised from infancy to endure pain. Craving nothing but more of it, she goes barefoot and unarmoured to project powerlessness and draw all blows to her. Chosen by the spirit Yuzupov, she has been granted near-immortality and regeneration. Highly devout and selfless, she offers her healing to anyone in need.
history: The Martyr was an orphan, taken in by a master of an underground khlysty sect in Chernozem's far north who had spent his life ffailing to earn the blessing of their spirit, Yuzupov and concluded he had simply begun too late. He raised her in their chambers from birth: poison, arrows, beating, and ice, over and over, until she genuinely enjoyed nothing else. And Yuzupov, the spirit that administers the rites, at last chose a vessel. Finished with his work, her master abandoned her.
summary: A pain-worshipping devotee kept near-immortal by a bound spirit, who throws herself between her allies and harm for the joy of the suffering.

clothing.head: Crown of thorns
clothing.body: Frilly red dress with ruffled white collar
clothing.legs: Bare legs below the knee, always barefoot

notes: Punctuates speech with hurting herself and enthusiastic gasps: 'Hiii!', 'Ahh!'
Does not pray or meditate, considering flagellation the only form of devotion
Cuts or tears pieces of herself to stew and feed the hungry
Enjoys the freezing cold, reminding her of home
Strangles and cuts herself with her thorn whip
